text:
Marie (CS): FYI customer Ledgerly opened an urgent request: they got a sequence of 401s while doing bulk embed ingestion and asked for completed SIG/CAIQ + KMS access evidence by next Wednesday. Due date looks firm from their compliance group.

Sam G (Infra): ack, can you paste the exact error payloads and a repro?

Marie (CS): pasted below, quick repro from their engineering team (they ran this against our hosted inference endpoint):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"open-lite-embed-1","input":["a","b","c"]}'
```
Response snippets they forwarded: `{"error":"unauthorized","code":401}` then intermittently `{"error":"rate_limit","code":429}` then a sudden `{"error":"internal_server_error","code":500}`. They said this started at 2026-03-14T16:03:21Z and lasted ~18 minutes.

Sam G (Infra): hmm - looks like two things: an auth/keys issue and then a capacity fallback. Did they rotate keys recently? Also we saw a small autoscale event at 16:02 which may have caused backend routing to churn. I'll pull routing logs.

Alex P (Security): @Marie (CS) can you confirm they want KMS/HSM access logs (key usage) + proof of key wrapping? For CAIQ we generally supply: KMS provider & HSM details, key rotation policy, access control list snapshot, and audit-log exports for requested window.

Marie (CS): yes, ledgerly's compliance explicitly asked for: KMS key usage for the affected window (2026-03-14 15:55 -> 16:20 UTC), CAIQ answers for encryption & key management, and evidence of audit log retention (how long logs are retained and where).

Jordan (PM): Also note their billing team flagged a big cost jump aligned with that time window. They posted a billing CSV showing a spike of ~32k token units in that 18-minute window which looks anomalous. Can infra correlate request ids to token tallies?

Sam G (Infra): I'll query request logs for that time range and map request_id -> token_count -> model. If there's an automated retry loop (client-side) that can explain the spike.

deploy-bot: "autoscale-event:pool-12 scaled from 6 -> 2 @ 2026-03-14T16:02:18Z (policy: idle-down)"

Sam G (Infra): that autoscale down at 16:02 is suspicious — scaling down while inbound traffic increased could cause errors and retries. I can already see a handful of `connect_timeout` and `503` entries.

Marie (CS): Ledgerly says they did not rotate API keys. They shared one session log where they got 401, then retried 5x within seconds. They included our request_id `rq_8f7a1b` in one of the payloads. See their snippet: `{"request_id":"rq_8f7a1b","status":"401","ts":"2026-03-14T16:03:05Z"}`

Sam G (Infra): pulling our internal logs for `rq_8f7a1b`...

Sam G (Infra): internal log lines for rq_8f7a1b: `2026-03-14T16:03:05Z ERROR auth: token not found user=ledgerly-prod client_ip=52.14.22.9`, then `2026-03-14T16:03:06Z INFO proxy: routed to replica r-3c4a`, then `2026-03-14T16:03:07Z ERROR backend: handshake failed code=ETIMEDOUT replica=r-3c4a`

Sam G (Infra): conclusion prelim: a transient token validation issue (cache miss or KMS lookup delay) followed by autoscaler churn that led to client retries and some internal 500s. Could produce both the 401/429/500 sequence.

Alex P (Security): For CAIQ and their bespoke questions we need to provide: (1) KMS provider and instance IDs (we can provide redacted HSM IDs), (2) key rotation logs showing last rotation and schedule, (3) access control snapshot for the service principal that signed their tokens, (4) audit log export for 2026-03-14 15:50 -> 16:30 UTC. I can produce signed export but need infra to pull the logs and KMS audit lines.

Sam G (Infra): pulling: audit-log export generation started. I can pull CloudKMS audit entries and our proxy auth logs. Expected artifacts: `kms-audit-20260314-1550-1630.csv` and `proxy-auth-20260314-1550-1630.jsonl`. ETA ~45m.

Marie (CS): I'll tell Ledgerly we're compiling the CAIQ and KMS evidence and that we have a tentative delivery timeline. They also want confirmation of retention policy for audit logs (they asked if logs are retained 1 year+).

Alex P (Security): We retain high-fidelity audit logs 13 months (GCP stackdrive/CloudAudit) and lower fidelity aggregated metrics 24 months. I'll include the retention policy excerpt and a signed statement.

Jordan (PM): Thanks. Also: customer asked for a remediation plan for preventing future incidents and a billing adjustment if the spike was caused by server-side retries. Can finance weigh in once we confirm cause?

Marie (CS): I've opened a formal escalation case with finance and billing: ESC-2026-0887. Will route updates once infra confirms whether retries were server-triggered.

Sam G (Infra): quick repro steps for infra to reproduce locally (for the record):
1) provision two replicas, set auth cache TTL=30s
2) simulate intermittent KMS latency `tc qdisc` delay on kms-agent 1000ms for 30s
3) send 200 parallel embed requests with existing key -> observe 401s then retries

Sam G (Infra): test script snippet:```bash
for i in {1..200}; do \
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST https://staging.redwood/v1/embeddings \\n    -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-staging-REDACTED" \\n    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n    -d '{"model":"open-lite-embed-1","input":["x"]}' &
done; wait
```

Alex P (Security): once infra has the logs, I'll redact customer identifiers, assemble CAIQ answers, and sign the package. Marie, please confirm whether Ledgerly wants the full audit export via a secure share (SFTP) or if we should deliver a redacted summary in the CAIQ answers.

Marie (CS): they requested full evidence over an encrypted S3 share with a signed access token. I'll coordinate creds.

Jordan (PM): next steps & owners: Sam -> pull and deliver audit/artifacts (ETA 45m). Alex -> assemble CAIQ answers & signed statement (ETA EOD). Marie -> communicate interim status to Ledgerly and arrange secure transfer. Finance -> waiting on infra correlation for billing adj.

Alex P (Security): flagged for priority. Adding: we should include HSM attestation document and last KM rotation PGP-signed digest.

Marie (CS): ledgerly replied: "thank you — please confirm by EOD tomorrow or we will escalate to our legal/compliance." I'll chase. :pray:

Sam G (Infra): uploaded `kms-audit-20260314-1550-1630.csv` to secure staging. Sharing link to Alex & Marie via DM.

Alex P (Security): got it, will redact and incorporate into CAIQ package.

Marie (CS): noted. closing loop here once Alex posts final package. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Jordan (PM): adding this to post-incident runbook for autoscale: consider min-replicas during business hours and KMS retry/backoff tuning.

Marie (CS): I'll mark the thread as escalated -> severity: high, due date: 2026-03-18 (CAIQ due).
